active.title: Sunset Horse Ride Through Pigeon Valley
active.description: Dalton Brothers Ranch runs two-hour trail rides through Pigeon Valley and the White Valley at the hour the light turns golden — the horses know the trail better than the guide, and the route ends at a viewpoint earned entirely on horseback.
active.bonus: Tell your horse something you haven’t said out loud to anyone else this week.

active.title: Sunrise Hike: Çavuşin to Paşabağ via Zelve
active.description: A 2-hour cross-country walk from the abandoned Greek village of Çavuşin through the Zelve Open Air Museum to the mushroom-shaped fairy chimneys at Paşabağ — best done before 7am when the rock carries its own orange light and no tour groups have arrived.
active.bonus: Start before sunrise. Be at Çavuşin when the first light hits the stone.

active.title: Explore Derinkuyu Underground City
active.description: An 18-storey city built underground 3,000 years ago — the tunnels descend 85 metres and once housed 20,000 people. You crouch, crawl, and occasionally decide you trust the ceiling; the reward is a complete rethinking of what civilisation means.
active.bonus: Go all the way to the lowest accessible level. Don’t stop at the first comfortable floor.

active.title: Mountain Bike the Red and Rose Valley Loop
active.description: Rent bikes in Göreme and ride the 14 km compacted dirt loop through Red Valley and Rose Valley — one demanding climb, two long descents, and formations looming overhead the entire route.
active.bonus: No stopping for photos during the climb. Earn the view at the top first.

adventure.title: Scooter to Uçhisar Castle at Sunset
adventure.description: Rent a scooter in Göreme and ride 4 km to Uçhisar — the highest naturally formed rock castle in Cappadocia — arriving with 30 minutes before dark. The 360-degree view from the summit puts the entire valley in frame as the light fails.
adventure.bonus: Climb to the very top. Don't stop at the first good view.

adventure.title: Hot Air Balloon at Sunrise over Göreme Valley
adventure.description: Royal Balloon launches before dawn and floats you above the fairy chimneys of the Göreme valley as the sun climbs over the horizon — the most photographed view in Turkey and the only one worth waking up at 4am for.
adventure.bonus: Don't touch your phone for the first ten minutes in the air. Just be there.

adventure.title: Hike the Ihlara Valley Gorge
adventure.description: A 16 km canyon trail along the Melendiz River with Byzantine cave churches carved into the cliff walls at eye level — start at Selime Monastery, hike south to Ihlara village, and swim in the river when your legs say so.
adventure.bonus: Enter at least one cave church. Spend five minutes inside with your phone put away.

adventure.title: ATV Ride Through Rose Valley at Golden Hour
adventure.description: Rent an ATV from the operators at the Göreme village entrance and ride the track through Rose Valley at 5pm when the volcanic rock turns terracotta — 8 km of trail through formations that were old when Constantinople was new.
adventure.bonus: Stop once and turn the engine off. Sit in the silence for two minutes before riding on.

foodie.title: Village Cooking Class in Ortahisar
foodie.description: One of the family-run cooking workshops in Ortahisar teaches a three-course traditional Cappadocian meal from scratch — mantı, gözleme, and a regional dessert — in a kitchen that’s been producing the same food for generations. You eat the result.
foodie.bonus: Cook one dish entirely from memory the following week. No recipe.

foodie.title: Wine Tasting at Kocabağ Winery
foodie.description: Cappadocia has been producing wine since 4000 BC. Kocabağ in ÜRGÜP is the most established local producer — the cellar tour takes 40 minutes, and the structured tasting of their Emir and Öküzgözü varietals requires no prior knowledge of Turkish wine to enjoy.
foodie.bonus: Bring a bottle home. Open it at the exact right moment.

foodie.title: Cave Dinner at Seki Restaurant, Argos
foodie.description: Seki occupies a wine cellar cut into the hillside at Argos in Cappadocia — a tasting menu built around Anatolian ingredients, an open kitchen, and a wine list sourced exclusively from Cappadocian vineyards.
foodie.bonus: Order the wine pairing without looking at the prices first. Trust the sommelier.

social.title: Rooftop Cocktails at Sultan Cave Suites
social.description: The terrace bar at Sultan Cave Suites has an unobstructed view over the fairy chimney valley — spectacular at sunrise for balloon watching, equally good after dark when the formations are lit and the rooftop fills with people who made the right decision.
social.bonus: Talk to someone from a country you've never visited. Get one real piece of information about how they live.

social.title: Pottery Workshop in Avanos
social.description: Avanos has produced red-clay pottery since the Hittites — the workshops on the main street give you access to a master potter and two hours on the wheel using the same terracotta technique practiced here for 4,000 years.
social.bonus: Make something for someone specific. Tell them who it’s for before you give it.

social.title: Cave Bar Night in ÜRGÜP Old Quarter
social.description: ÜRGÜP’s old quarter has a cluster of wine bars and cocktail spots built into cave walls along cobblestone alleys — start at Karma Şarap Evi, work uphill through the neighbourhood, and end at whichever bar has the best terrace view at midnight.
social.bonus: Order something from the local wine list you’ve never heard of. Ask the server to explain what you’re drinking.

social.title: Whirling Dervish Ceremony in ÜRGÜP
social.description: The Sema ceremony — the Sufi spinning meditation of the Mevlevi Order — is performed weekly in ÜRGÜP’s cultural centre. The 45-minute ceremony is not a performance; watch accordingly.
social.bonus: Arrive early and sit in the front row. Show up fully.

chill.title: Watch the Balloons from Sunrise Hill
chill.description: A 20-minute walk from the centre of Göreme leads to the ridge above Love Valley — at 5am you stand above the launch field as 100 hot air balloons ascend through the valley below you. Watching them from above is better than riding one.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone in your pocket until all the balloons are airborne. Watch it happen first.

chill.title: Sunset Walk Through Devrent Valley
chill.description: Walk Devrent Valley in the late afternoon when the angle of low sun turns the volcanic formations from beige to orange to blood red — the landscape changes colour every 20 minutes and is best understood at walking pace.
chill.bonus: Name three formations before looking up what locals call them. Your names will be better.

chill.title: Göreme Open Air Museum in the Afternoon
chill.description: A 10th-century monastic settlement with Byzantine frescoes intact inside cave chapels — the apses still oriented east, the paint still vivid. Come after 2pm when the morning tour groups have cleared out and you can sit alone in a 1,000-year-old church.
chill.bonus: Find the fresco that affects you most. Sit in front of it for five minutes.

chill.title: Turkish Bath at Tarihî Göreme Hamamı
chill.description: The hammam sequence — hot room, kese exfoliation, foam massage, cold plunge — takes 90 minutes and leaves you loose-limbed in a way no modern spa can replicate. Tarihî Göreme Hamamı has been operating since the Ottoman period.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone outside the hammam entirely. Not in a locker — outside.
